Messages.Author: pittboo
Messages.Body:
Haave two questions for you.

1. If a torpered vampier has the Palatial Estate on them do they still gain
the 1 blood from it?

2. If you contest your on vampire and one of them is in torpor which one do
you burn the active one or the torpered one.

These two questions have come up in our group a few times.

Thanks for the help
Droz

Messages.Author: Michael Beer
Messages.Body:
pittboo wrote:

> Haave two questions for you.
>
> 1. If a torpered vampier has the Palatial Estate on them do they still gain

yes

>
>

> 2. If you contest your on vampire and one of them is in torpor which one do

It's your choice. You can even burn both.
